text_block_list.text:
The day before the fall Tenno Sho, Air
Groove's
mother comes to visit us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув's mother is worried about
whether her
uptight daughter is enjoying
herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's filled with relief after witnessing
the bond
that Эйр Грув and I have
built.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After some brief quality time together,
Air
Groove sees her mother off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
